about.heading: Intego Yacu
about.body: Muri VerifyAI, twizera isi aho ukuri kunesha. Itsinda ryacu ry'abashakashatsi b'indashyikirwa, abahanga mu bya porogaramu, n'abanyamakuru bakorera hamwe kugira ngo babe intambwe imwe imbere y'amakuru y'ubukorano n'ibikorwa byateguwe byo gukwirakwiza amakuru y'ibinyoma. Turi umuryango wigenga witangiye kubaka ibikoresho bya AI bigaragara kandi bidafite aho bibogamiye ku nyungu rusange.
